opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore majors into gold and critical-minerals juniors

opportunities.rationale: Red Sea risk and domestic energy transition support WDS, WLE, SXG; policy tailwind from energy inflection narrative

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore major exposure; hedge with gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crash is confirmed; BHP/RIO/FMG face earnings downgrades; gold provides commodity hedge
No spring bounce at auctions, falling house prices, and weak credit growth pressure GPW, ICOL, and bank NIMs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer ahead of Fed meeting and geopolitical escalation
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed decision, Red Sea risk, and AI policy uncertainty create elevated volatility; liquidity is prudent

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower over 1–3 months. Iron ore crash and oil-driven input costs weigh on materials and consumer sectors. Fed meeting and Red Sea escalation are key volatility triggers. Junior mining and energy names offer relative outperformance.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA eases into housing weakness. Energy transition and critical-minerals pipeline support structural themes. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising, pressuring REITs and banks. AI policy resolution will reduce global volatility.
